fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects usage of the Quarks PwDump tool via commandline arguments
fields.name: HackTool - Quarks PwDump Execution
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "\\QuarksPwDump.exe" or (tgt.process.cmdline in (" -dhl"," --dump-hash-local"," -dhdc"," --dump-hash-domain-cached"," --dump-bitlocker"," -dhd "," --dump-hash-domain ","--ntds-file"))))
